metrics.method: Full history 2025-08-25 → 2026-09-18: 1857 non-service messages (1102 client 'LA Client' / 755 our side; the 'Lauryn chat team' vendor group and all '| Chat Manager'-style senders counted as our side). client_questions_total = client messages containing '?'. Strict first-reply-by-anyone lag is excellent (median 0.03h, mean 1.6h, p90 3.2h, max 43.1h) and yields only 1 raw breach over 24h; unanswered_over_24h=4 instead counts client questions with no SUBSTANTIVE answer inside 24h, grouping repeat nudges on one topic as one item: invoice split 2026-07-19 (43h); Zelle-email-not-working 2026-08-07 (39h); 'What our update?' 2026-08-13 after a broken 2-hour promise; and the Facebook chase thread of 2026-09-02/03 ('Any updates???' / 'We still in review ??' / '???'), which was never answered to her — the 2026-09-14 reply, 12 days later, was addressed to the colleague who tagged on her behalf and contained no information. max_team_silence_days = longest run with zero human outbound from our side excluding automated leak-scan broadcasts (9.6d, 2025-12-05 → 2025-12-15); raw longest gap including broadcasts is 8.1d (2025-12-23 → 2025-12-31). Promises = explicit dated or actionable commitments made by our side; 15 kept, 18 lapsed or overdue at cutoff (including 5 pending-but-overdue-by-owner-record), 2 unverifiable from the transcript and excluded from both counts. The client, by contrast, has kept every payment commitment and never disputed a cent in 13 months.

(2026-09-14). The first time in thirteen months anyone planned around her cash cycle instead of chasing it; it preceded the fastest, cleanest settlement on record. Make it standard on every invoice, for every client who pays out of platform drops.

The single report + 14-day game plan Sophie delivered on 2025-09-23 — 'Thank you for this Report... I think we are on the right track / Moving Upward 📈 / Stradgey makes sense', engaged with inside four hours. One strategic artefact in twelve months, and it landed perfectly.
top_fix: Make delivery evidence a precondition of invoicing. One named owner per account who must post, in the chat and in the client's own terms, a dated status on every open issue plus the period's numbers BEFORE the invoice goes out — and a written handover to the client whenever any staffer or vendor team leaves. Lauryn lost her relationship manager silently on 2025-10-09 and her entire chat team silently on 2026-06-10; from those two moments nobody owned her numbers, no report was ever sent again, the Facebook block ran 356 days, and the only contact she had left with us was a bill. This week she paid that bill down to zero out of her own OnlyFans drops, received a missed DMCA update and an unreadable custom link in return, and was then told she had been paying the owner's personal account. Nothing about the relationship will change until we cannot bill her without first showing her what she bought.
